english: where your treasure is, there will your heart be also

terms.latin: Ubi enim est thēsaurus tuus, ibi est et cor tuum.
terms.comment: Christ’s words in the Clementine Vulgate; some editions read ibi erit et cor tuum.

terms.latin: Ubi est thēsaurus tuus, ibi est et cor tuum.
terms.comment: The verse without enim, as it is quoted on its own.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Vulgate verses checked against the Clementine text at Bible Study Tools and the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror).
